ReasoningPluginIdentity.title: Reasoning plugin identity tuple
ReasoningPluginIdentity.description: The one identity every authority of the hub reasoning composition agrees on: its Cargo component package, the composition root's builder id and package_id, the deployment catalog row, the generated registry row and the canonical `s.<plugin>.<artifact>` owner segment. The component crate NAME and the playground VARIANT are deliberately different names and are pinned here so the three can never be conflated.
